name: RDXHIVE
legal: RDXHIVE (trading name), operated by Rajon Dey (formerly Rajon Dey X Technologies)

positioning.company: RDXHIVE is a global software company. We build client products and platforms, and we operate our own.
positioning.market: Websites & CRM automation for marketing agencies
positioning.marketLong: RDXHIVE builds agency websites and connects them to your CRM — fixed projects from $1,000.

voice.tone: Precise, calm, and senior. Short sentences. No hype, no fake proof, no marketplace energy.
avoid: Fiverr or Upwork in a hero or primary section
Rajon Dey as a primary H1
Invented metrics, star ratings, or logo walls

pillars: We build client products and platforms, and we operate our own.
Fixed scope. Named prices. No open-ended retainers as the default offer.
Proof is named work with honest attribution — never invented counts.
A global remote team. One name: RDXHIVE.

logo.markFill: #0D1421 or white. currentColor for UI that inherits text color.
logo.clearSpace: 25% of mark height on all sides
logo.rules: H symbol in ink on paper or white on dark. UI lockup is the symbol plus typeset RDXHIVE in Instrument Serif roman. Tagline is a separate line. Never put the hex field on the mark.
do: Use the H symbol on light (ink) or dark (white)
Pair the symbol with typeset RDXHIVE in Instrument Serif roman for UI
Use stacked lockup when width is tight (covers, avatars, OG)
Use horizontal lockup on wide headers and documents
Keep Many minds. One direction. as a separate line, not inside the nav lockup
doNot: Fill or overlay the H with the hex pattern
Recolor the mark to accent, teal, or green (#10B901, #1dbf73)
Stretch, rotate, outline, or add shadows
Set the wordmark in Playfair, Inter, or italic
Use the full identity sheet (/rdxhive-branding.png) as a logo

accent.note: Restrained teal. Do not use #10B901 or #1dbf73.

hexInk.note: Hive motif only. Never on the H mark.

typography.italic: Editorial headlines only. Never in the logo or nav wordmark.

productBrand.parentMark: The H mark stays ink on paper or white on dark. Never recolor it for a child product.
productBrand.childAccent: One optional accent per product, named in that product’s spec. Until then, ink only. Never #10B901, #1dbf73, or the parent teal as the child identity.
productBrand.legal: Trading name stays RDXHIVE. Product sites use Product by RDXHIVE — do not invent a separate legal entity.
futureChecklist: Lock the name (closed compound, like YearInReview)
Do not replace or recolor the parent H mark
One optional accent hex — not #10B901, #1dbf73, or parent teal
